title: Where We Find Meaning Matters: How Anchors of Work Meaningfulness Relate to Work and Life Well-Being
affiliations: INSEAD and INSEAD

detail.title: Where We Find Meaning Matters: How Anchors of Work Meaningfulness Relate to Work and Life Well-Being

publicationDetails.detailsText: INSEAD Working Paper No. 2025/59/OBH
publicationDetails.journalName: INSEAD Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Work is increasingly being recognized as a central arena through which individuals derive meaning and purpose in life and as a key contributor to one's subjective well-being in both domains. Yet, most research typically treats work meaningfulness as unidimensional, capturing the overall extent to which work feels meaningful, without considering what aspects of work specifically make it so. This conceptual simplification overlooks theoretical perspectives from fragmented research traditions emphasizing different sources of meaning, ranging from internal callings to external job characteristics and social relationships. Accordingly, we address two key questions in this research: (1) What are the different aspects of work to which individuals attribute meaningfulness-that is, what makes their work feel significant, worthwhile, or personally fulfilling? (2) How do these distinct attributions relate to subjective well-being, both at work and in life? Across three studies (N = 1,599), we inductively develop and validate a multidimensional framework-that we term anchors of work meaningfulness-comprising six distinct anchors: Livelihood, Community, Stimulation, Recognition, Impact, and Rejuvenation. We further examine how different anchors relate to subjective well-being and find that individuals who anchor work meaningfulness in Community, Stimulation, and Impact report higher well-being at work. Moreover, those anchoring work meaningfulness in Community and Impact report higher overall life well-being. These findings offer important theoretical and practical implications by introducing a unified framework of work meaningfulness, offering a validated measure for future research, and demonstrating how distinct sources of meaning uniquely enrich wellbeing across work and life domains.

detail.abstract: Today's era is a digital era. We consumers can almost get any product by a single click at our door step. Digital marketing has become the part of new normal. Hyper-personalization is a strategy used in digital marketing where the companies utilize AI and other advanced technologies to create tailored experiences for the customers. Traditional CRM makes use of general data of the customers like names, history of purchases etc. But hyper-personalization goes beyond this. By making use of this strategy, the companies or brands can stand out from the rest of the competitors. This paper attempts to explore the different strategies used in hyper-personalisation to enhance brand visibility and customer engagement. The paper further analyses how hyper-personalisation is different from traditional CRM and how the concept of hyper-personalisation benefits both the marketers as well as the customers.

detail.abstract: Micro, Small and Medium Scale Enterprises (MSME's) have been the backbone of Indian Economy. Industry 4.0 focussed on blending technologies into manufacturing process. Fifth Industrial Revolution or Industry 5.0 emphasises the integration between humans and machines. Its main objective is to establish a collab between human creativity and advanced technologies like artificial intelligence and machine learning. One of the key aspects of Industry 5.0 is hyper-personalisation, where the companies use advanced analytics to predict consumer behaviour to create tailored experiences to each of their customers. This research paper will explore how micro, small, and medium scale enterprises could align themselves with the objectives of Industry 5.0 and bring in hyper-personalisation into their businesses which could lead to sustainable growth and development and creation of customer centric business models.

title: EU vs. U.S. Minimum-Tax Architectures after Pillar Two: The Future Role of EU State Aid Enforcement
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Queen Mary University of London, School of Law

detail.title: EU vs. U.S. Minimum-Tax Architectures after Pillar Two: The Future Role of EU State Aid Enforcement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Both authors declare that they have no conflicts of interest and no financial, professional, or institutional links to any stakeholder that could be affected by the subject matter of this article.

keywords: tax competition and harmful tax practices

detail.abstract: This article analyzes the implementation of the OECD’s global minimum corporate tax (“Pillar Two”) in the European Union versus the United States’ international tax reform approach, and the implications for tax incentives and fair competition. In particular, it provides an overview of what tax incentives remain permissible under Pillar Two and under recent U.S. tax reforms, and how these are structured. It also examines the June 2025 G7 “side-by-side” agreement that carved out U.S.-parented multinationals from Pillar Two, discussing whether this transatlantic compromise can withstand EU legal scrutiny – including State aid rules and the EU’s new Foreign Subsidies Regulation. Throughout, EU State aid policy remains a key issue, given its ongoing role in policing tax benefits and subsidies in the post-Pillar Two landscape.

title: Agentic AI in Capital Markets: From Automation to Institutional Intelligence
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Agentic AI in Capital Markets: From Automation to Institutional Intelligence
detail.abstract: Capital markets today face a critical gap: despite technological sophistication, institutions remain slow, fragmented, and bottle-necked by organisational cognition. Automation and predictive AI have undoubtedly enhanced operational efficiency and forecasting precision. Yet these systems stop short of the one capability markets now demand-decision ownership at machine scale. Agentic AI re-frames software from being a tool into a form of institutional intelligence. These systems sense market conditions, form hypotheses, execute actions, evaluate outcomes, and adapt-all under governance. This is not artificial intelligence as we know it. It is autonomy with intent. This paper introduces the Institutional Intelligence Loop, an original architectural model comprising seven cognitive zones orbiting a core: the Institutional Intent Engine. This framework represents a living system designed to simulate reasoning, perceive shifts, act within ethical bounds, and evolve continuously. Illustrative applications include the AI Risk Officer, capable of real-time exposure reasoning and preemptive de-risking; the Autonomous Trading Supervisor, which adjusts strategies and detects adverse selection; the Compliance Intelligence Agent, which explains behaviour in regulator-native terms; and the Institutional Client Agent, which anticipates allocation changes and enhances advisory precision. These use cases converge on a single imperative: decision velocity without loss of control. The road-map to institutional intelligence begins with copilot systems, matures into supervised autonomy, and culminates in exception-driven AI governance. The decisive edge is no longer in execution or data. It lies in the ability to think fast, think clearly, and think safely-at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"机构智能循环"架构模型，将AI从工具转变为具有决策所有权的机构智能系统，实现规模化自主决策而不失控制。
AI.research_question: 如何构建能够实现规模化自主决策、具备决策所有权的AI系统，以解决资本市场中机构决策速度慢、碎片化和组织认知瓶颈的问题？
AI.motivation: 当前资本市场面临关键缺口：尽管技术先进，但机构决策仍然缓慢、碎片化，受组织认知瓶颈制约。现有自动化和预测性AI虽提升了操作效率和预测精度，但缺乏市场所需的规模化决策所有权能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机构智能循环（Institutional Intelligence Loop）理论框架，包含七个认知区域围绕核心"机构意图引擎"的架构模型，代表一个能够模拟推理、感知变化、在伦理边界内行动并持续进化的生命系统。
AI.method: 提出原创架构模型，通过四个应用案例进行说明：AI风险官、自主交易监督员、合规智能代理和机构客户代理，展示框架的实际应用。
AI.findings: 代理式AI能够将软件从工具转变为机构智能形式，使系统能够感知市场条件、形成假设、执行行动、评估结果并适应，所有过程都在治理框架下进行。关键发现是实现"决策速度而不失控制"的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"机构智能循环"原创架构模型；2. 引入"机构意图引擎"核心概念；3. 建立从副驾驶系统到监督自主再到异常驱动AI治理的演进路线图；4. 重新定义AI为"具有意图的自主性"。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. AI风险官：实时风险推理和预防性去风险；2. 自主交易监督员：调整策略并检测逆向选择；3. 合规智能代理：以监管者熟悉的术语解释行为；4. 机构客户代理：预测配置变化并提升咨询精度。这些应用共同实现决策速度与控制之间的平衡。

detail.title: Chapter 2: Organizational Readiness and Change Management in the Age of AI-Driven Business Analytics
detail.abstract: Organizational readiness has crystallized as a principal determinant of success in managed change within turbulent contexts. This chapter reconceptualizes readiness as a composite framework encompassing psychological alignment, cultural resonance, structural competency, and technological fitness. Building on empirical studies of healthcare reform, enterprise digital transformation, and Industry 4.0, the analysis demonstrates that readiness is a reliable predictor of implementation success, a regulator of resistance, and a facilitator of sustained change. It devotes special attention to the preconditions that must be satisfied to embed artificial intelligence and advanced analytics within decision-making processes. Effective AI integration demands constant, enterprise-level commitment that transcends purely technological expenditure-it is ultimately contingent upon the simultaneous readiness of human, procedural, and data domains. Organizations that develop this portfolio of capacities are in a stronger position to translate AI-generated insights into demonstrable value; however, neglecting holistic readiness exposes firms to inefficient resource deployment and project abandonment. The chapter argues that leadership behavior and prevailing cultural norms serve as essential moderators, influencing whether preparedness is amplified or eroded during transformation. By weaving together a rigorous theoretical foundation, robust empirical validation, and practical managerial guidance, the work repositions readiness as a continuously evolving suite of capabilities. title: AI Literacy and Workforce Transformation
affiliations: University of Madras

detail.title: AI Literacy and Workforce Transformation

keywords: AI Literacy and Workforce Transformation AI literacy

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has become a disruptive technology that is transforming the face of education, industry, and society. This rapid alignment has posed a two-song necessity to develop AI literacy and navigate workforce changes. AI literacy is not confined to technical proficiency alone; it is broader, encompassing knowledge, critical judgment, ethical judgment, and socio-cultural consciousness. Workforce transformation, in turn, indicates the impacts of AI on work (in terms of automation and augmentation) to reorganize work and job structure and to alter the necessary skills. This chapter has synthesized the last 40 open-access reports published between 2023 and 2025, basing its evidence on education, human resource management, and organizational practice. The methodology used was narrative synthesis, which involves background coding in areas of literacy systems, educational interventions, and workforce adaptations. The findings demonstrate that AI literacy is multidimensional; education offers context for literacy pipelines. Workforce transformation is remarkably hastened in HR and organizational practices. Literacy acts as a facilitator of adaptability and resilience. However, unresolved issues remain, including inequities, ineffective measurement instruments, and fragmented models. The discussion focuses on AI literacy as the interface that connects education to the labor force, allowing people to be critical and companies to be innovative without diminishing the lives of others. The conclusion emphasizes that a transformation of the workforce may be discriminatory and inequitable without explicit efforts being made to improve literacy. The future looks promising in terms of cross-sectoral frameworks, interventions with a focus on equity, AI-enhanced learning ecosystems, and models of human-AI collaboration. The chapter provides a timely insight into how to achieve sustainable change in the human workforce by positioning AI literacy as a key driver of change within institutions and the rural workforce.

title: The Business Need for Pre-Assignment Training of Indian Expatriates Transferring to Thailand
affiliations: and Suresh Gyan Vihar University Jaipur

detail.title: The Business Need for Pre-Assignment Training of Indian Expatriates Transferring to Thailand

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no conflicts of interest or personal relationships that have influenced this review.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was conducted in accordance with recognised ethical standards for human-subject research. All participants were informed of the purpose of the study, their voluntary participation, and their right to withdraw at any time without consequence. No identifiable personal data was collected, and all responses have been fully anonymised to ensure confidentiality. The research followed the principles of the Thai Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA B.E. 2562), and all data were stored securely and used solely for academic purposes. As the study involved minimal risk and collected only non-identifiable information, formal institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research has received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Indian professionals are one of the fastest-growing groups of expatriates in Thailand's corporate sector. While there is some research on expatriate adjustment and cross-cultural training, there remains a significant gap in understanding the business need and return on investment (ROI) of pre-assignment training for Indian assignees to Thailand. This is significant because of the cultural differences, communication styles, and workplace norms that Indians may encounter in Thailand. To explore this issue, the study uses a qualitative approach through semi-structured interviews with 15 senior Indian expatriates who transferred to Bangkok between 2020 and 2025. It looks at how structured pre-departure training affects work readiness, cultural adjustment, relationship building, and early job performance. The findings suggest that poor preparation results in longer on-boarding processes, slower team integration, and lower work performance. In contrast, focused cultural orientation, basic language lessons, and organisational support for family-related concerns significantly improve early integration and job effectiveness. The study proposes a model that connects pre-assignment training to successful assignments. It also offers practical advice for HR professionals on incorporating cultural, linguistic, organisational, and family factors into global mobility policies. These insights emphasise the importance of structured preparation in improving expatriate outcomes and reducing unnecessary organisational costs.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了印度外派人员赴泰国前的预派遣培训对工作准备度、文化适应、关系建立和早期工作绩效的影响，发现结构化培训能显著改善外派成果并降低组织成本。
AI.research_question: 预派遣培训对印度外派人员赴泰国的工作准备度、文化适应、关系建立和早期工作绩效有何影响？
AI.motivation: 印度专业人士是泰国企业部门增长最快的外派群体之一，但现有研究对外派调整和跨文化培训的关注不足，特别是对印度外派人员赴泰国的预派遣培训的业务需求和投资回报率存在显著研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外派调整理论、跨文化培训理论、投资回报率（ROI）分析框架
AI.method: 质性研究方法，通过对2020-2025年间调往曼谷的15名印度高级外派人员进行半结构化访谈
AI.findings: 准备不足导致入职流程延长、团队融入缓慢和工作绩效降低；而集中的文化导向、基础语言课程和组织对家庭相关问题的支持能显著改善早期融入和工作效率
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将预派遣培训与成功外派任务联系起来的概念模型，丰富了外派调整和跨文化培训理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为人力资源专业人员提供实用建议，将文化、语言、组织和家庭因素纳入全球流动政策，强调结构化准备在改善外派成果和降低不必要组织成本方面的重要性

title: Survivorship Bias in Emerging Market Small-Cap Indices: Evidence from India's NIFTY Smallcap 250

detail.title: Survivorship Bias in Emerging Market Small-Cap Indices: Evidence from India's NIFTY Smallcap 250

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, personal, or professional conflicts of interest influencing this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required as the study uses publicly available market data and involves no human or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study quantifies survivorship bias in India's NIFTY Smallcap 250 index using a comprehensive dataset of 1,437 stocks over nine years (2016- 2025). By reconstructing historical index composition through market-capitalization ranking and comparing equal-weight portfolios of current survivors versus all historical constituents, I find that survivor-only backtesting artificially inflates annual returns by 4.94 percentage points (23.3% relative overstatement) and Sharpe ratios by 0.097 points (9.1% relative overstatement). The analysis reveals an 82.5% removal rate, comprising delisted stocks (16.1%), stocks that graduated to larger market capitalizations (33.1%), and demoted stocks (33.2%). Critically, I demonstrate that all three removal categories—including successful graduations—create survivorship bias by systematically excluding portions of the historical investment universe. Using complete historical price data from daily bhavcopy files, which uniquely include delisted securities, My Index methodology is validated by a 100% accuracy in identifying current index constituents, leading to an estimated 85-90% accuracy across the entire historical period, substantially exceeding the 80-85% accuracy typical in published research. These findings have important implications for strategy evaluation in emerging markets, where higher portfolio turnover and corporate volatility amplify bias effects relative to developed markets. The results suggest that systematic trading research in Indian equities requires complete historical universes rather than current constituent lists to avoid materially overstating strategy performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了印度NIFTY Smallcap 250指数的生存偏差，发现仅使用幸存股票进行回测会人为夸大年化收益率4.94个百分点（相对夸大23.3%），夏普比率夸大0.097点（相对夸大9.1%）。研究使用包含已退市股票的完整历史数据，揭示了82.5%的移除率，包括退市股票（16.1%）、升级到大市值股票（33.1%）和降级股票（33.2%）。
AI.research_question: 印度NIFTY Smallcap 250指数存在多大的生存偏差？不同类型的股票移除（退市、升级、降级）如何影响回测结果的准确性？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场（特别是印度）的股票指数具有较高的投资组合周转率和公司波动性，这可能会放大生存偏差效应。现有研究通常使用当前成分股列表进行回测，忽略了历史投资宇宙的完整性，可能导致策略表现被严重夸大。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生存偏差理论、投资组合回测方法论、市场效率理论、新兴市场特征理论
AI.method: 使用2016-2025年印度1,437只股票的全面数据集，通过市值排名重建历史指数成分，比较当前幸存股票等权重组合与所有历史成分股等权重组合的表现差异。使用包含已退市证券的每日bhavcopy文件获取完整历史价格数据。
AI.findings:
1. 生存偏差导致年化收益率夸大4.94个百分点（相对夸大23.3%），夏普比率夸大0.097点（相对夸大9.1%）
2. 总移除率为82.5%，包括退市股票（16.1%）、升级到大市值股票（33.1%）和降级股票（33.2%）
3. 所有三类移除（包括成功的升级）都会产生生存偏差
4. 研究方法在识别当前指数成分股方面达到100%准确率，整个历史时期估计准确率为85-90%，显著高于已发表研究的80-85%
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 量化了新兴市场小盘股指数的生存偏差程度
2. 证明不仅退市股票，升级和降级股票也会产生生存偏差
3. 提供了更准确的历史指数重建方法
4. 扩展了生存偏差理论在新兴市场的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为印度股票市场的系统性交易研究提供方法论指导
2. 强调使用完整历史投资宇宙而非当前成分股列表的重要性
3. 帮助投资者和研究人员避免策略表现被夸大
4. 为新兴市场的投资策略评估提供实证依据

title: Flexible contract for a comprehensive Military Equipment Maintenance Management Service (MEMMS) solution

detail.title: Flexible contract for a comprehensive Military Equipment Maintenance Management Service (MEMMS) solution
detail.abstract: R2C2 Global proposes a flexible contract for Military Equipment Maintenance Management Service (MEMMS) with Ukraine's Ministry of Defense. It offers efficient maintenance to minimize equipment failures and downtime, including system review, inventory, resource assessment, and repairs. MEMMS optimizes mean-time between failures, focuses on tiered strategic/operational/tactical maintenance, supports multi-domain operations, and integrates supply chains for high readiness at economical cost. Developed by US military and commercial experts, it emphasizes training, safety, and transition to Ukrainian control.

AI.tldr: R2C2 Global为乌克兰国防部提供灵活的军事装备维护管理服务合同，通过系统化维护策略优化设备可靠性，减少故障和停机时间，强调培训、安全和最终向乌克兰控制过渡。
AI.research_question: 如何通过灵活的合同安排为乌克兰国防部提供高效的军事装备维护管理服务，以最小化设备故障和停机时间？
AI.motivation: 乌克兰国防部需要可靠的军事装备维护服务来确保装备可用性，但面临资源有限、技术不足等挑战，需要专业的外部支持来提升维护效率和装备战备状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于设备可靠性工程、维护管理理论、供应链整合理论，以及分层维护策略（战略/作战/战术层面）和多域作战支持框架。
AI.method: 采用系统化维护管理方法，包括系统审查、库存管理、资源评估、维修执行，以及优化平均故障间隔时间（MTBF）的工程实践。
AI.findings: MEMMS服务能够有效提升军事装备的可靠性和战备状态，通过整合供应链和分层维护策略，以经济成本实现高可用性，同时支持培训和安全标准提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了军事装备维护管理的灵活合同模式，提出了整合商业和军事专业知识的维护服务框架，丰富了多域作战环境下的装备保障理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰国防部提供了可操作的维护解决方案，建立了从外部支持到本土控制的过渡机制，提升了装备维护效率和战备能力，具有实际应用价值。

title: Business Intelligence, Strategy Innovation, and Digital Value Creation for Business Performance on Digital Creative Industries
affiliations: PGRI Yogyakarta University, University of Pembangunan Nasional “Veteran” Jakarta, PGRI Yogyakarta University and PGRI Yogyakarta University

detail.title: Business Intelligence, Strategy Innovation, and Digital Value Creation for Business Performance on Digital Creative Industries
detail.abstract: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises' (MSMEs) business performance in digital creative industries still remain an issue in Indonesia. This paper evaluates the influence of business intelligence on business performance through digital value creation mediated by innovation strategy. This research is conducted in the digital creative industries using 104 respondents consisting of managers and company owners in Indonesia. The method used is Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The results show that business intelligence exhibits positive and significant impact both on digital value creation and innovation strategy. Apart from that, innovation strategy exhibits positive and significant impact on digital value creation. Lastly, digital value creation exhibits positive and significant impact on business performance. Likewise, the indirect influence of all variables in the model shows positive and significant results. A major limitation of this study is the study sample. Since the sample covers only eight cities in Indonesia, it does not represent the whole of Indonesia. However, since no empirical study has evaluated business intelligence through digital value creation mediated by strategy innovation, this study makes a unique contribution to business performance on digital creative industries in Indonesia.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了印度尼西亚数字创意产业中微型、小型和中型企业（MSMEs）的业务表现问题。研究发现，商业智能通过数字价值创造和创新战略的中介作用，对业务绩效产生积极且显著的影响。
AI.research_question: 商业智能如何通过数字价值创造和创新战略的中介作用影响印度尼西亚数字创意产业中微型、小型和中型企业（MSMEs）的业务绩效？
AI.motivation: 印度尼西亚数字创意产业中微型、小型和中型企业（MSMEs）的业务表现仍然存在问题，需要研究如何通过商业智能、数字价值创造和创新战略来提升其绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于商业智能、数字价值创造、创新战略和业务绩效的理论框架，探讨这些变量之间的因果关系和中介效应。
AI.method: 采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM），对印度尼西亚数字创意产业的104名管理者和公司所有者进行问卷调查分析。
AI.findings:
1. 商业智能对数字价值创造和创新战略均有积极且显著的影响
2. 创新战略对数字价值创造有积极且显著的影响
3. 数字价值创造对业务绩效有积极且显著的影响
4. 模型中所有变量的间接影响均呈现积极且显著的结果
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过数字价值创造和创新战略的中介作用评估商业智能对业务绩效的影响，为数字创意产业的业务绩效研究提供了独特的理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度尼西亚数字创意产业的MSMEs提供了实践指导：通过投资商业智能系统，结合创新战略，创造数字价值，从而提升业务绩效。研究结果有助于企业制定有效的数字化转型策略。

title: Theory Z+1: Redefining Managerial Trust and Human-AI Synergy in the Hybrid Work Era
affiliations: and Suresh Gyan Vihar University Jaipur

detail.title: Theory Z+1: Redefining Managerial Trust and Human-AI Synergy in the Hybrid Work Era
detail.abstract: Purpose: This paper introduces Theory Z+1, an advanced management paradigm extending McGregor's Theory X and Y and Ouchi's Theory Z into AI-enabled and hybrid work environments shaped by social media influence. Design/methodology/approach: Using a conceptual analysis, this paper synthesises literature on AI transparency, techno-humanistic leadership, hybrid-work autonomy, continuous learning, and digital boundary management to develop an integrated model suitable for contemporary organisational settings. Findings: Theory Z+1 demonstrates how trust, collective responsibility, and digital transformation imperatives interact to support employee trust, well-being, and innovation in AI-enabled hybrid workplaces. The framework consolidates algorithmic transparency, techno-humanistic leadership, digital boundary sensitivity, and learning cultures, highlighting their combined impact on organisational adaptability. Research limitations/implications: As a conceptual framework, Theory Z+1 requires empirical validation through future studies that employ qualitative, mixed-method, and SEM-based quantitative approaches. Practical implications: The model guides organisations in balancing technological augmentation with empathy-driven leadership, supporting sustainable AI-enabled management while accounting for the organisational impact of social media. Social implications: Theory Z+1 advocates for a management system that ensures that workplaces are psychologically safe, inclusive, and ethically managed by encouraging responsible AI implementation, transparency, awareness of digital boundaries, and autonomy in hybrid work environments, all of which promote fair participation and the long-term sustainability of the workforce. Originality/value: This is the first framework to extend Theory Z to a digitally mediated environment, integrating AI governance and social media dynamics into a testable, future-oriented management model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Theory Z+1管理范式，将McGregor的Theory X/Y和Ouchi的Theory Z扩展到AI赋能的混合工作环境，整合了AI透明度、技术人文领导力、数字边界管理等要素，构建了适应数字时代的管理框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将传统管理理论（Theory X/Y/Z）扩展到AI赋能的混合工作环境中，并整合社交媒体影响，构建适合当代组织环境的管理范式？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术和混合工作模式的普及，传统管理理论需要更新以适应数字化工作环境，特别是考虑到社交媒体对组织的影响，需要发展新的管理框架来支持员工信任、福祉和创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于McGregor的Theory X/Y和Ouchi的Theory Z，整合AI透明度、技术人文领导力、混合工作自主性、持续学习和数字边界管理等理论，构建Theory Z+1综合模型。
AI.method: 采用概念分析方法，综合AI透明度、技术人文领导力、混合工作自主性、持续学习和数字边界管理等相关文献，构建整合模型。
AI.findings: Theory Z+1展示了信任、集体责任和数字化转型需求如何相互作用，支持AI赋能混合工作场所中的员工信任、福祉和创新。该框架整合了算法透明度、技术人文领导力、数字边界敏感性和学习文化，突出了它们对组织适应性的综合影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Theory Z扩展到数字中介环境，整合AI治理和社交媒体动态，构建了可测试的、面向未来的管理模型，为管理理论在数字时代的演进提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了平衡技术增强与同理心驱动领导力的指导，支持可持续的AI赋能管理，同时考虑社交媒体的组织影响，帮助创建心理安全、包容和伦理管理的工作场所。

title: The Game of Stakes™: A Doctrinal Thesis on the Architecture of Elite Trust

detail.title: The Game of Stakes™: A Doctrinal Thesis on the Architecture of Elite Trust

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Founder and Principal Researcher of The Mohgix Institute of Cinematic Strategy, a division of Mohgix Studios LTD. The proprietary frameworks discussed in this paper (including The Game of Stakes™, The Clarity Tax™, and The Strategic Void™) are the intellectual property of the Institute.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This manuscript is a theoretical and doctrinal thesis; it does not involve human subjects, clinical trials, or the collection of private personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by The Mohgix Institute of Cinematic Strategy, a division of Mohgix Studios LTD.

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Mohgix Institute of Cinematic Strategy

detail.abstract:
This paper presents the foundational doctrine of The Game of Stakes™, arguing that the market for strategic services is not a single arena but a bifurcation of two mutually exclusive games: the Game of Scale™ and the Game of Stakes™. 

It posits that the mass-market noise of the Game of Scale creates a systemic market failure-the Strategic Void™ [1]-and a resultant opportunity for Psychological Arbitrage among an underserved elite clientele. 

The thesis asserts that the Game of Stakes™ is governed by the economics of trust, where asymmetrical information problems are solved through costly signaling and the adoption of a peer-level posture. The ultimate measure of competence in this arena is integrity; operational failure is not merely a setback but results in the absolute and total liquidation of reputational capital. 

The paper concludes that victory in this arena is not measured by transactional volume but by the achievement of Strategic Sovereignty, an outcome attainable only by a firm (Mohgix) that embodies doctrinal conviction, intellectual rigor, and absolute integrity (the Architect not Strategist doctrine).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"赌注游戏"理论，认为战略服务市场分为两个互斥的游戏：规模游戏和赌注游戏。规模游戏的市场噪音导致"战略真空"市场失灵，为精英客户创造了"心理套利"机会。赌注游戏由信任经济学驱动，通过成本信号和同级姿态解决信息不对称问题，最终以诚信为能力衡量标准，失败会导致声誉资本完全清算。胜利的标准是获得"战略主权"，这需要公司具备教义信念、智力严谨和绝对诚信。
AI.research_question: 战略服务市场如何运作？是否存在不同的竞争逻辑？精英客户在战略服务市场中面临什么问题？如何解决战略服务市场中的信息不对称问题？
AI.motivation: 识别战略服务市场的系统性市场失灵（战略真空），理解规模游戏产生的市场噪音如何导致精英客户需求未被满足，探索为精英客户提供高质量战略服务的替代模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 赌注游戏理论、信任经济学、成本信号理论、信息不对称理论、声誉资本理论、战略主权概念、建筑师而非战略家教义。
AI.method: 概念分析、理论构建、逻辑论证、市场结构分析、竞争动态分析。
AI.findings: 1. 战略服务市场分为两个互斥游戏：规模游戏（大众市场）和赌注游戏（精英市场）；2. 规模游戏产生市场噪音，导致"战略真空"市场失灵；3. 赌注游戏由信任经济学驱动，通过成本信号和同级姿态解决信息不对称；4. 诚信是赌注游戏中的核心能力衡量标准；5. 失败会导致声誉资本完全清算；6. 胜利标准是获得战略主权，而非交易量。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出战略服务市场的二分法理论框架；2. 发展信任经济学在战略服务中的应用；3. 引入成本信号和同级姿态作为解决信息不对称的机制；4. 建立声誉资本在精英服务市场中的核心地位；5. 提出战略主权作为新的成功衡量标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为精英客户识别心理套利机会；2. 为战略服务提供商提供差异化竞争策略；3. 强调诚信和声誉管理的重要性；4. 为Mohgix公司提供"建筑师而非战略家"的运营教义；5. 帮助企业实现战略主权而非单纯追求交易量。

title: Son Preference in Parental Time: Do Families Invest More Care in Male Children?
affiliations: Apna.Co

detail.title: Son Preference in Parental Time: Do Families Invest More Care in Male Children?
detail.abstract: India's strong son preference is well-documented in fertility decisions, sex-selective abortion, and inheritance patterns. Using India's 2024 Time Use Survey (10.2 million observations from 139,489 households), we examine whether son preference extends to differential parental time investment. We construct household child gender composition from individual records and link to parental time use. We find evidence that household child composition influences parental childcare time allocation. The analysis controls for family size, parental age, education, employment, and state fixed effects. These patterns suggest that son preference may operate not just in who is born but in how children are raised, with potentially important implications for gender inequality reproduction across generations. Causal interpretation is limited by cross-sectional data and potential fertility selection.

AI.tldr: 使用印度2024年时间使用调查数据，研究发现印度强烈的重男轻女偏好不仅影响生育决策和性别选择性堕胎，还延伸到父母时间投资差异上，男孩家庭中父母花更多时间照顾孩子。
AI.research_question: 印度的重男轻女偏好是否延伸到父母对子女的时间投资差异上？
AI.motivation: 印度存在强烈的重男轻女偏好，这在生育决策、性别选择性堕胎和继承模式中已有充分记载，但尚不清楚这种偏好是否也体现在父母对子女的时间投资差异上。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重男轻女偏好理论、父母投资理论、性别不平等代际传递理论
AI.method: 使用印度2024年时间使用调查数据（139,489个家庭的1020万条观察记录），从个人记录构建家庭子女性别构成，并与父母时间使用数据关联。控制家庭规模、父母年龄、教育、就业和州固定效应。
AI.findings: 家庭子女构成影响父母育儿时间分配，表明重男轻女偏好不仅影响谁出生，还影响子女抚养方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了重男轻女偏好的理论框架，表明这种偏好不仅体现在生育决策中，还延伸到子女抚养过程中的时间投资差异，为性别不平等代际传递机制提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了重男轻女偏好如何通过日常育儿实践再生产性别不平等，为政策制定者设计干预措施减少性别不平等提供了实证依据。

title: Alcohol Prohibition, Sexually Transmitted Infections and Other Health Outcomes

detail.title: Alcohol Prohibition, Sexually Transmitted Infections and Other Health Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Several studies have examined the impact of nudge-driven alcohol restriction policies on Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs) and other health outcomes. This evidence is mixed and comes from developed countries. In this paper, I focus on a comprehensive and statewide alcohol ban in Bihar, an underdeveloped region where poor healthcare leads to a reservoirs of STIs and puts the population at a significantly greater risk. I use propensity score-matched difference-indifferences (DiD) with (rosenbaum bounds) to find that self-reported STIs have declined among men by ten percent. The decline in STI is greater in districts where the alcohol consumption has declined sharply. I also use an alternate control group. As a robust check, I provide DiD and triple difference estimates of the impact of the ban on self-reported health outcomes, such as thyroid, cancer, oral cavity, and diabetes, among others. I do not find evidence of improvements in other health outcomes.

AI.tldr: 比哈尔邦全面禁酒政策显著降低了男性自我报告的性传播感染率约10%，但在其他健康指标（甲状腺、癌症、口腔疾病、糖尿病等）上未见改善效果
AI.research_question: 比哈尔邦全面禁酒政策对性传播感染和其他健康结果有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有关于酒精限制政策对性传播感染影响的研究结果不一致，且主要来自发达国家。比哈尔邦作为欠发达地区，医疗条件差导致性传播感染高发，酒精禁令可能产生不同影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的助推理论（nudge theory），酒精消费与性传播感染之间的行为联系，区域发展差异对政策效果的影响
AI.method: 使用倾向得分匹配的双重差分法（PSM-DiD）配合罗森鲍姆边界分析，同时采用替代对照组进行稳健性检验，并使用三重差分法分析其他健康指标
AI.findings:
1. 男性自我报告的性传播感染率下降约10%
2. 酒精消费下降更明显的地区，性传播感染下降幅度更大
3. 其他健康指标（甲状腺、癌症、口腔疾病、糖尿病等）未见显著改善
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 在欠发达地区验证了酒精限制政策对性传播感染的影响
2. 揭示了政策效果的区域异质性
3. 表明酒精禁令对性传播感染的特定效果，而非普遍健康改善
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为欠发达地区制定针对性酒精政策提供实证依据
2. 建议政策制定者关注酒精消费与性传播感染的特定联系
3. 提示需要结合其他干预措施来改善整体健康状况

title: Development Plans, Economic Indicators and Planning Challenges in Iran (1979-2022)
affiliations: Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies

detail.title: Development Plans, Economic Indicators and Planning Challenges in Iran (1979-2022)
detail.abstract: In the decade of 1979-1988, there was no development plan in Iran. During 1989-2022, six development plans implemented in Iran's economy. The assessment of development plans conducted based on the performance and the results of economic indicators over the period. Economic Growth over the course of development plans was volatile. There has been a double-digit inflation rate over the course of the development plans and Productivity and the distribution of income indices were volatile. The challenges of planning in Iran include lack of common understanding on basic concepts of development plans, challenges of comprehensive plan, essential change due to external shocks, time span, parallel initiatives, coordination failure and lack of independent evaluation entity.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了伊朗1979-2022年间的经济发展计划，发现经济增长波动、持续高通胀、生产率不稳定，并识别了规划过程中的七大挑战。
AI.research_question: 伊朗1979-2022年间经济发展计划的实施效果如何？存在哪些主要挑战？
AI.motivation: 伊朗在1979-1988年间没有发展计划，1989-2022年间实施了六个发展计划，需要系统评估这些计划的实施效果和存在的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济发展计划评估理论、宏观经济指标分析框架、规划制度理论
AI.method: 基于经济指标表现的评估方法，分析1979-2022年间的宏观经济数据
AI.findings: 1. 经济增长在发展计划期间波动剧烈；2. 通胀率持续保持两位数高位；3. 生产率和收入分配指数不稳定；4. 识别出七大规划挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家经济发展计划评估提供了实证案例，丰富了规划制度理论在实践中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊朗未来发展规划提供了改进建议，识别了规划过程中的关键挑战，有助于提高规划有效性

reference: GMU Working Paper in Economics ...; Washington Law Review, Vol. 59, No. 27, pp. 27-60 (1983)
title: Restricted Distribution Contracts and the Opportunistic Pursuit of Treble Damages
affiliations: George Mason University - Antonin Scalia Law School

detail.title: Restricted Distribution Contracts and the Opportunistic Pursuit of Treble Damages

publicationDetails.detailsText: GMU Working Paper in Economics ...
publicationDetails.journalName: George Mason University Department of Economics Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Washington Law Review, Vol. 59, No. 27, pp. 27-60 (1983)

detail.abstract:
Section 4 of the Clayton Act grants private parties the right to recover treble damages resulting from an antitrust violation. The economic goal of the treble damage award is to deter antitrust violations through increasing both the probability of enforcement by rewarding private actions and the cost of getting caught. Legal commentators, as well as economists, continue to debate the efficacy of the treble damage action as a means of promoting consumer welfare. 

It is clear that the threat of treble damage actions tends to deter all types of potential antitrust violations. The problem is that some of the behavior discouraged may be procompetitive behavior. Such a result is not consistent with the antitrust goal of promoting consumer welfare. This is particularly true of actions brought by a distributor against a manufacturer with whom the distributor had signed a restricted distribution contract. Although the United States Supreme Court has recognized the procompetitive aspects of some restricted distribution practices, it is still possible for most of them to be attacked as unlawful restraints of trade under section 1 of the Sherman Act. The analysis presented in this article addresses the narrow issue of the effects of potential treble damage actions on the behavior of contractually-related manufacturers and distributors.

Part II of this article presents the notion of opportunistic behavior, which has influenced much of the economic analysis and the Supreme Court's recent treatment of vertical nonprice restraints. The transformation of the threat of opportunism into socially-wasteful expenditures of resources is also discussed.

Part III examines the problematic role of opportunism in the distribution of goods, restricted distribution practices that aim to solve the problem, and the antitrust treatment of such restricted distribution practices. This part argues that, in terms of controlling opportunism, which is the substantive purpose of the practice, the Supreme Court's formalistic distinction between price and nonprice restraints is not useful. 

Part IV examines the perverse incentives created by the current antitrust treatment of restricted distribution practices. Part IV begins with an analysis of contract law damages and the incentives to engage in opportunistic behavior through inducing breach and collecting damages when stipulated damage clauses provide for damages greater than actual damages. The analysis is then extended to the antitrust treatment of restricted distribution contracts where the threat of a treble damage action is viewed as an implicit government-mandated clause stipulating damages greater than actual damages. Thus, the incentives to engage in opportunistic behavior through the manipulation of restricted distribution contract terms are the same as under other contracts when stipulated damages are greater than actual damages. This part argues that the pursuit of treble damages in restricted distribution cases is another form of opportunistic behavior, and that the threat of such opportunistic behavior increases the costs of procompetitive distribution practices and thus decreases consumer welfare. The opportunistic pursuit of treble damages also explains why distributor and franchisee terminations are among the most actively litigated categories of antitrust actions. 

Part V discusses the policy implications of the analysis. Although it is clear that the perverse incentives created by the current state of the antitrust law of restricted distribution practices could be eliminated by declaring all such practices to be per se legal, the narrow scope of the analysis does not support such a sweeping recommendation. Instead, Part V recommends that when the true basis of an action is a dispute concerning a voluntary contract between vertically-related parties, the problem of the opportunistic pursuit of treble damages should be minimized by adopting a uniform rule of reason for all restricted distribution practices and by revitalizing the in pari delicto defense to antitrust actions.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了三倍赔偿条款在反垄断法中对限制性分销合同的影响，指出虽然三倍赔偿旨在威慑违法行为，但也可能阻碍促进竞争的行为，特别是当经销商利用三倍赔偿条款进行机会主义诉讼时，这会增加促进竞争的分销实践成本，降低消费者福利。
AI.research_question: 三倍赔偿条款对限制性分销合同中制造商和经销商行为的影响是什么？特别是，这种条款如何可能被用于机会主义诉讼，从而阻碍促进竞争的分销实践？
AI.motivation: 《克莱顿法案》第4条允许私人当事人就反垄断违法行为获得三倍赔偿，旨在通过提高执法概率和违法成本来威慑违法行为。然而，这种威慑可能不仅针对反竞争行为，也可能阻碍促进竞争的行为，特别是在限制性分销合同背景下。本文关注三倍赔偿条款如何影响合同相关制造商和经销商的行为。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 机会主义行为理论：分析合同关系中一方利用信息不对称或法律条款谋取私利的行为
2. 反垄断经济学：特别是关于垂直限制（价格与非价格限制）的经济分析
3. 合同法损害赔偿理论：特别是约定赔偿条款与实际损害赔偿的关系
4. 最高法院对垂直非价格限制的最新处理方式
AI.method:
本文采用法律经济分析方法，通过理论分析探讨三倍赔偿条款在限制性分销合同中的激励效应。具体方法包括：
1. 法律文本分析：分析《克莱顿法案》第4条和《谢尔曼法案》第1条
2. 案例法分析：考察最高法院对限制性分销实践的判决
3. 经济激励分析：分析三倍赔偿条款如何改变合同各方的行为激励
4. 比较分析：将反垄断三倍赔偿与合同法中的约定赔偿条款进行比较
AI.findings:
1. 三倍赔偿条款的威慑效应是双刃剑：既威慑反竞争行为，也可能阻碍促进竞争的分销实践
2. 在限制性分销合同中，经销商可能利用三倍赔偿条款进行机会主义诉讼，特别是当制造商终止合同时
3. 最高法院对价格限制和非价格限制的形式主义区分在控制机会主义方面没有实际效用
4. 三倍赔偿威胁相当于政府强制的约定赔偿条款，赔偿金额超过实际损害，这会激励机会主义行为
5. 这种机会主义诉讼增加了促进竞争的分销实践成本，从而降低消费者福利
6. 经销商和特许经营终止是反垄断诉讼最活跃的类别之一，部分原因就是机会主义的三倍赔偿追求
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将机会主义行为理论应用于反垄断三倍赔偿分析，提供了新的理论视角
2. 将反垄断三倍赔偿与合同法约定赔偿条款进行理论类比，揭示了相似的经济激励结构
3. 挑战了最高法院对价格与非价格限制的形式主义区分，提出了基于实质目的（控制机会主义）的分析框架
4. 为理解限制性分销合同中的诉讼模式提供了理论解释
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 政策建议：对所有限制性分销实践采用统一的合理原则分析，而不是形式主义的区分
2. 法律改革建议：在反垄断诉讼中恢复"同等过错"抗辩，以减少机会主义诉讼
3. 司法实践指导：当诉讼实质是垂直相关方之间的合同纠纷时，应最小化三倍赔偿的机会主义追求
4. 为立法者和法院提供了具体的改革方向，以平衡威慑效应与避免阻碍促进竞争行为

title: Inflow and Outflow of Oil Revenues: Scenarios for National Development Fund of Iran (NDFI)
affiliations: Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies

detail.title: Inflow and Outflow of Oil Revenues: Scenarios for National Development Fund of Iran (NDFI)
detail.abstract: Resource-rich developing countries are forced by economic fluctuations due to international commodity price movement. One way to reduce the volatility adverse effects is to establish institutions such as Sovereign Wealth Fund. However, the way this fund is managed is important. Iran, as a resource-rich developing country, suffers from economic fluctuations. To manage resource revenues, National Development Fund (NDF) has been established. In this paper, using DSGE model, we examined different scenarios for managing fund resources. A scenario, without any stabilizer Fund and two different scenarios for National Development Fund. In the second scenario, NDF has a role like the one in Sixth Development Plan. In the third scenario, all oil revenues are deposited to NDF and a part of the fund as much as interest rate in the OECD countries plus 70% of long-run oil revenues invested in the economy. The Results indicated that the management of oil revenues by the Fund, in which the inflow of oil revenues into the economy follows the commitment, is an appropriate policy to reduce the economic fluctuations in Iran.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用DSGE模型分析伊朗国家发展基金（NDF）不同管理方案对经济波动的影响，发现遵循承诺规则将石油收入注入经济的基金管理模式能有效减少伊朗的经济波动。
AI.research_question: 主权财富基金（特别是伊朗国家发展基金）的不同管理方案如何影响资源丰富发展中国家的经济波动？
AI.motivation: 资源丰富的发展中国家受国际商品价格波动影响，经济波动显著。伊朗作为这类国家，虽建立了国家发展基金（NDF）来管理资源收入，但基金的具体管理方式对经济稳定效果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权财富基金理论、资源诅咒理论、经济稳定化政策理论、动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）建模框架
AI.method: 使用动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，比较三种不同管理方案：1）无稳定基金；2）按第六个发展计划规定的NDF角色；3）所有石油收入存入NDF，按OECD国家利率加70%长期石油收入投资于经济
AI.findings: 遵循承诺规则将石油收入注入经济的基金管理模式（第三种方案）是减少伊朗经济波动的适当政策
AI.theory_contributions: 为资源丰富发展中国家的主权财富基金管理提供了理论框架，验证了承诺规则在减少经济波动中的有效性，丰富了DSGE模型在资源收入管理政策评估中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊朗政府提供了具体的NDF管理政策建议，为其他资源丰富发展中国家设计主权财富基金管理规则提供了参考，提出了可操作的投资分配公式（OECD利率+70%长期石油收入）

title: Fiscal Policy Uncertainty and Economic Activities in Iran's Provinces
affiliations: Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies

detail.title: Fiscal Policy Uncertainty and Economic Activities in Iran's Provinces

publicationDetails.detailsText:
International Journal of Business and Development Studies, Vol. 17, Iss. 1, pp. 75-101,
https://doi.org/10.22111/ijbds.2025.51549.221

detail.abstract: The positive impacts of fiscal policy could be undermined when accompanied by uncertainty. We examined the effect of fiscal policy uncertainty on economic activities in the provinces of Iran. It includes production, investment, unemployment, and economic participation of the active workforce in these provinces, taking into account the effects of economic sanctions imposed on the economy. We employed two types of shocks: fiscal level shock (representing fiscal policy) and its volatility shock (as fiscal policy uncertainty), which derived from a specified fiscal reaction function. We estimated a Panel VAR model using provincial data from 2003 to 2020. The results of the impulse response function indicated that following the impulse in the fiscal policy uncertainty, the response shows an increase in the unemployment rate in the short run, a decrease in the capital investment, and an increase in the inflation rate in the short and medium terms. In the medium and long term, the response indicates a decrease in GDP growth and a reduction in the economic participation rate of the active workforce.

AI.tldr: 研究伊朗各省财政政策不确定性对经济活动的影响，发现财政政策不确定性冲击会导致短期失业率上升、投资下降、通胀上升，中长期则降低GDP增长和劳动力参与率。
AI.research_question: 财政政策不确定性如何影响伊朗各省的经济活动（生产、投资、失业、劳动力参与）？
AI.motivation: 财政政策的积极影响可能被不确定性所削弱，特别是在伊朗面临经济制裁的特殊背景下，需要研究财政政策不确定性对省级经济的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财政反应函数理论，区分财政水平冲击（财政政策）和波动性冲击（财政政策不确定性），分析不确定性对宏观经济变量的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用面板VAR模型，利用2003-2020年伊朗省级数据，从指定的财政反应函数中推导出两种冲击：财政水平冲击和波动性冲击（财政政策不确定性）。
AI.findings: 财政政策不确定性冲击导致：短期失业率上升、资本投资下降、通胀率在短期和中期上升；中长期GDP增长下降、活跃劳动力经济参与率降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 在伊朗经济制裁背景下，实证检验了财政政策不确定性对省级经济的影响，扩展了不确定性经济学在发展中经济体应用的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊朗政策制定者提供实证依据，强调在实施财政政策时需要管理不确定性，以促进经济增长、就业和投资，特别是在制裁环境下。

title: Balancing Fairness And Efficiency In Order Allocation For Quick-Commerce Applications

detail.title: Balancing Fairness And Efficiency In Order Allocation For Quick-Commerce Applications
detail.abstract: Purpose-This study proposes an approach for deciding the optimal allocation of orders in context of last-mile delivery services. We attempt to model and analyze the inherent trade-off between operational efficiency (driving the least to deliver orders while adhering to delivery time guarantees) and fairness (equitable distribution of earning opportunities). Design/Methodology/Approach-The study proposes to convert the dual objective of delivery efficiency and rider fairness into a single formulation. This conversion is done by weighing the two objectives using a tunable parameter λ, that balances fairness and efficiency. The resulting model is a minimum-cost assignment problem, incorporating conventional VRP constraints such as multi-stop pickups, order batching, and rider-specific attributes (e.g., capacity, idle time). Given the computational complexity of the theoretical model, our study proposes a two-stage heuristic which breaks the problem into two sub-problems namely, creation of efficient routes and finding a minimum cost assignment. Finally, the approach is tested on a real-world dataset (NYC yellow taxi data). Findings-The simulations show that there is an average increase of 4-5 percent in delivery time while leading to a 33 percent decrease in inequality as the emphasis on fairness (measured using Gini index) is increased. The use of the approach allows a graded movement across all values of fairness as it not only prioritized even distribution of earnings but also incentivized low performing groups. Research Limitations-Our approach, first of its kind attempts to model the two competing objectives. We demonstrate our approach on synthetic as well as a real world dataset. However, the insights derived from the dataset, might not be immediately applicable to all e-commerce platforms worldwide. Region-specific data would be required for such a conclusion. Practical Implications-We find that prioritizing fairness (measured using Gini coefficient), leads to decrease in delivery efficiency, and increase in average delivery time. Platforms can use our model to incrementally modify the policy, allowing them to manage the trade-off between rider welfare (fairness) and customer satisfaction (efficiency). Originality/Value-The novelty of this work lies in its integrated two-stage model, which combines a VRP route generator with a fairness-aware MILP assignment while allowing a graded movement between the two extremes. This study provides a theoretical approach for balancing the interests of the two major players in an e-commerce setting.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种平衡最后一公里配送效率与骑手公平性的订单分配方法，通过可调参数λ权衡两个目标，使用两阶段启发式算法解决计算复杂度问题，实验显示公平性提升33%时配送时间仅增加4-5%。
AI.research_question: 如何在最后一公里配送服务中优化订单分配，平衡运营效率（最短配送距离和准时送达）与公平性（骑手收入机会的公平分配）？
AI.motivation: 电商平台需要同时满足客户对配送效率的需求和骑手对公平收入分配的需求，这两个目标存在内在冲突，需要建立系统化的权衡框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 车辆路径问题（VRP）理论、公平分配理论（基尼系数衡量）、多目标优化理论、最小成本分配问题。
AI.method: 将双目标转化为单目标公式，使用可调参数λ权衡公平与效率；提出两阶段启发式算法：1）创建高效路线，2）最小成本分配；在纽约出租车真实数据集上进行模拟测试。
AI.findings: 模拟结果显示：当强调公平性（基尼系数降低）时，配送时间平均增加4-5%，但不平等程度降低33%；该方法允许在公平与效率之间进行渐进调整，既能优先考虑收入公平分配，又能激励低绩效群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次建立同时建模配送效率与骑手公平性的理论框架；提出结合VRP路线生成与公平感知MILP分配的两阶段集成模型；提供在电商环境中平衡多方利益的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 平台可使用该模型渐进调整政策，管理骑手福利（公平性）与客户满意度（效率）之间的权衡；为配送平台提供可操作的决策支持工具。

title: A Bibliometric Analysis of Decentralized Finance Research: Adoption, Digital Transformation, and Sustainability in Urban Contexts
affiliations: and School of Economics and Commerce, CMR University

detail.title: A Bibliometric Analysis of Decentralized Finance Research: Adoption, Digital Transformation, and Sustainability in Urban Contexts

declarations.ethicsApproval: No conflict
declarations.funderStatement: Private

detail.abstract: This study conducts a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of Decentralized Finance (DeFi) research, focusing on adoption, digital transformation, and sustainability within urban contexts. Utilizing a dataset of 284 publications from 2016 to 2025 compiled from the Scopus database, the analysis employs advanced bibliometric techniques and network visualization tools to reveal collaborative patterns, thematic clusters, and research evolution. Results demonstrate significant scholarly emphasis on technological innovation and adoption factors shaping DeFi's integration into urban financial ecosystems, alongside an increasing focus on sustainability. A regression-based Bibliometric Influence Score (BIS) adjusts for publication age and journal prestige, indicating that leading publications consistently exceed expected citation influence. Additionally, a conceptual framework is proposed linking digital financial literacy and sustainability outcomes, moderated by urban contextual factors. The findings underscore the importance of enhancing digital capabilities and mitigating systemic barriers to facilitate sustainable DeFi adoption in rapidly urbanizing regions, providing valuable insights for academia, policymakers, and practitioners engaged in fostering inclusive and resilient digital finance ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文对去中心化金融(DeFi)研究进行了全面的文献计量分析，重点关注城市背景下的采用、数字化转型和可持续性。基于2016-2025年Scopus数据库的284篇文献，分析揭示了合作模式、主题集群和研究演变，强调了技术创新和采用因素对DeFi融入城市金融生态系统的影响，以及日益增长的可持续性关注。
AI.research_question: 去中心化金融(DeFi)研究在城市背景下的采用、数字化转型和可持续性方面有哪些主要趋势、合作模式和知识演进？
AI.motivation: 随着DeFi在快速城市化地区的兴起，理解其研究格局、合作网络和可持续性影响对于促进包容性和韧性的数字金融生态系统至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量分析理论、网络分析理论、技术采用理论、数字金融素养理论、可持续金融理论
AI.method: 文献计量分析：基于Scopus数据库2016-2025年的284篇文献，采用先进的文献计量技术和网络可视化工具，包括回归基础的文献计量影响力评分(BIS)调整出版年龄和期刊声望
AI.findings: 1. 研究显示学术界显著强调技术创新和采用因素对DeFi融入城市金融生态系统的影响；2. 可持续性关注日益增长；3. 领先出版物持续超过预期的引用影响力；4. 揭示了合作模式和主题集群；5. 提出了连接数字金融素养和可持续性结果的概念框架，受城市背景因素调节
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了DeFi研究的文献计量分析框架；2. 开发了回归基础的文献计量影响力评分(BIS)；3. 构建了连接数字金融素养、城市背景因素和可持续性结果的概念框架；4. 揭示了DeFi研究的知识结构和演进模式
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为学术界提供了DeFi研究现状的全面概览；2. 为政策制定者提供了促进可持续DeFi采用的策略建议；3. 为实践者提供了增强数字能力和减轻系统性障碍的指导；4. 为快速城市化地区构建包容性和韧性的数字金融生态系统提供了实践洞见

title: Capitalizing on the Strengths of Young Adults with Psychosocial Disabilities to Enhance Service Ecosystem Resilience
affiliations: Queensland University of Technology, Queensland University of Technology - School of Advertising, Queensland University of Technology - QUT Business School, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Queensland University of Technology

detail.title: Capitalizing on the Strengths of Young Adults with Psychosocial Disabilities to Enhance Service Ecosystem Resilience
detail.abstract: This study examines how leveraging the strengths of young adults with psychosocial disabilities can enhance the resilience of a retail service ecosystem to vulnerability. Drawing from a strength-based perspective, the research highlights the importance of empowering these employees in organizational decision-making to address emotional, social, and process-related challenges. Using participatory design and social-emotional learning to develop and deliver strength-based transformative service initiatives, helps to illuminate three key adaptive capacities within the framing of self-determination theory that promote autonomy, competence, and relatedness. These capacities are pivotal in responding to vulnerability and fostering resilience within a retail service ecosystem and can be used as stabilizing and destabilizing tactics to enable organizations to prepare for, respond to, and adapt to present and future vulnerabilities for employees and customers. This study advances the transformative service research literature by reframing marginalized employees as key change agents.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨如何利用有心理社会障碍的年轻员工的优势来增强零售服务生态系统对脆弱性的韧性。研究采用优势视角，强调在组织决策中赋权这些员工以应对情感、社交和流程相关挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何通过利用有心理社会障碍的年轻员工的优势来增强零售服务生态系统对脆弱性的韧性？
AI.motivation: 传统上，有心理社会障碍的员工常被视为需要帮助的弱势群体，但本研究从优势视角出发，认为这些员工可以成为增强组织韧性的关键资源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 优势视角、自我决定理论（强调自主性、能力感和关联性）、变革性服务研究
AI.method: 采用参与式设计和社会情感学习方法来开发和实施基于优势的变革性服务举措
AI.findings: 识别出三种关键适应能力（基于自我决定理论的自主性、能力感和关联性），这些能力可作为稳定化和去稳定化策略，帮助组织为当前和未来的脆弱性做好准备、应对和适应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将边缘化员工重新定义为关键变革推动者，推进了变革性服务研究文献；将优势视角与自我决定理论结合应用于服务生态系统韧性研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了具体的策略来赋权有心理社会障碍的员工，增强服务生态系统的韧性；展示了如何通过参与式设计和社会情感学习开发有效的变革性服务举措。

title: User Preferences for Large Language Models: Implications for AI Safety and Market Structure
affiliations: London School of Economics and INSEAD

detail.title: User Preferences for Large Language Models: Implications for AI Safety and Market Structure
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) differ in their moderation and content policies, which determine which prompts these models refuse to answer. These refusals can affect user decisions of which models to use and whether to make safe or risky prompts. Using data from LMArena, where users select preferred responses to their prompts from paired LLM comparisons, we estimate a discrete choice model that captures user preferences for making risky prompts and their choice of which LLM provides the best response quality given the possibility of refusals. We leverage this model to analyze how moderation policies affect market shares across proprietary and opensource LLMs. Our findings reveal that proprietary LLMs provide higher quality responses and maintain larger market shares, but implement stricter moderation policies with higher refusal rates compared to open-source alternatives. This stricter moderation by proprietary LLMs reduces market concentration by allowing lower-quality open-source LLMs to compete effectively in the risky prompt segment. Mandating uniform moderation policies across all LLMs could increase market concentration favoring proprietary LLMs, potentially hampering competition. Our framework characterizes the efficient frontier of moderation policies that balance market concentration and safety.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过离散选择模型分析LLMs的审核政策如何影响用户偏好和市场结构，发现专有LLMs提供更高质量但拒绝率更高，这降低了市场集中度，让开源LLMs能在风险提示领域竞争。统一审核政策可能增加市场集中度，不利于竞争。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的审核政策和拒绝回答行为如何影响用户偏好、模型选择和市场结构？
AI.motivation: 不同LLMs在审核政策和内容政策上存在差异，这决定了模型拒绝回答哪些提示。这些拒绝行为会影响用户选择使用哪个模型以及是否提出安全或风险提示，从而影响市场竞争格局。
AI.theoretical_framework: 离散选择模型（discrete choice model），市场结构理论，竞争分析框架
AI.method: 使用LMArena平台数据，其中用户从成对的LLM比较中选择偏好的响应，估计离散选择模型来捕捉用户对风险提示的偏好以及在不同拒绝可能性下选择最佳响应质量的LLM。
AI.findings: 1. 专有LLMs提供更高质量的响应并保持更大的市场份额，但实施更严格的审核政策，拒绝率高于开源替代品。2. 专有LLMs的严格审核通过允许较低质量的开源LLMs在风险提示领域有效竞争，从而降低了市场集中度。3. 强制所有LLMs采用统一的审核政策可能会增加市场集中度，有利于专有LLMs，可能阻碍竞争。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了一个分析LLMs审核政策对市场竞争影响的框架。2. 提出了平衡市场集中度和安全性的审核政策效率前沿概念。3. 揭示了审核政策作为市场竞争工具的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于强制统一审核政策可能带来的竞争影响的见解。2. 为LLM开发者提供了关于如何通过审核政策策略性地定位产品的指导。3. 为用户提供了理解不同LLMs审核政策差异如何影响选择的信息。

title: The Role of Traditional Practices in Promoting Sustainable Business Practices in Northern Mindanao
affiliations: Independent, Independent and Independent

detail.title: The Role of Traditional Practices in Promoting Sustainable Business Practices in Northern Mindanao
detail.abstract: This study explores how traditional practices contribute to sustainable business in Poblacion Talisayan, Misamis Oriental. Many local businesses incorporate cultural heritage into their operations, helping to protect the environment, manage resources efficiently, and strengthen community-based entrepreneurship. By studying these practices, the research highlights their importance in maintaining economic stability while preserving local traditions. Using a qualitative approach, data was collected through interviews and observations of business owners who apply traditional methods. The findings show that these practices support sustainability by encouraging ethical business conduct, reducing waste, and improving local supply chains. The study also identifies challenges faced by entrepreneurs in keeping these traditions alive, especially with the pressures of modernization and globalization. The results indicate that traditional practices are not only beneficial for business but also essential for long-term sustainability. By combining indigenous knowledge with modern business strategies, entrepreneurs can maintain a balance between tradition and innovation. Additionally, support from the government and educational institutions can help these businesses continue thriving in the changing economic landscape. This research emphasizes the need to integrate traditional practices into sustainable business models. It calls on policymakers, business owners, and researchers to recognize the value of indigenous wisdom in economic and environmental development. Future studies may further explore ways to strengthen and promote these practices in the modern business world.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了菲律宾Poblacion Talisayan地区传统实践如何促进可持续商业发展，发现将文化遗产融入商业运营有助于环境保护、资源管理和社区创业，但面临现代化和全球化挑战。
AI.research_question: 传统实践如何促进Poblacion Talisayan, Misamis Oriental地区的可持续商业发展？
AI.motivation: 许多当地企业将文化遗产融入运营，有助于环境保护、资源高效管理和社区创业，但面临现代化和全球化压力，需要研究这些传统实践对可持续商业的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续商业理论、文化遗产保护理论、社区创业理论、传统知识与现代商业融合理论。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，通过访谈和观察收集数据，研究对象为应用传统方法的商业所有者。
AI.findings: 传统实践通过鼓励道德商业行为、减少浪费和改善本地供应链来支持可持续性；同时发现企业家在保持传统方面面临现代化和全球化压力等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了传统实践与可持续商业发展的理论框架，强调本土知识与现代商业策略结合的重要性，丰富了文化遗产与经济发展关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业家提供了结合传统与现代的商业策略；为政策制定者提供了支持传统商业发展的建议；为教育机构提供了培养相关人才的方向。

title: How and For Whom Using Generative AI Affects Creativity: A Field Experiment
affiliations: Tulane University, Renmin University of China, Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University, Rice University and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: How and For Whom Using Generative AI Affects Creativity: A Field Experiment
detail.abstract: We develop a theoretical perspective on how and for whom large language model (LLM) assistance influences creativity in the workplace. We propose that LLM assistance increases employees’ creativity by providing cognitive job resources. Furthermore, we hypothesize that employees with high levels of metacognitive strategies—who actively monitor and regulate their thinking to achieve goals and solve problems—are more likely to leverage LLM assistance effectively to acquire cognitive job resources, thereby increasing creativity. Our hypotheses were supported by a field experiment, in which we randomly assigned employees in a technology consulting firm to either receive LLM assistance or not. The results are robust across both supervisor and external evaluator ratings of employee creativity. Our findings indicate that LLM assistance enhances employees’ creativity by providing cognitive job resources, especially for employees with high (vs. low) levels of metacognitive strategies. Overall, our field experiment offers novel insights into the mediating and moderating mechanisms linking LLM assistance and employee creativity in the workplace.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）辅助如何以及为谁影响职场创造力。研究发现，LLM辅助通过提供认知工作资源提升员工创造力，且元认知策略水平高的员工更能有效利用LLM辅助来获取认知资源，从而显著提升创造力。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（LLM）辅助如何以及为谁影响职场员工的创造力？
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在工作场所的广泛应用，需要理解其对员工创造力的影响机制，特别是不同员工如何从这种技术辅助中受益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于认知资源理论和元认知理论，构建LLM辅助通过提供认知工作资源影响创造力的理论框架，并引入元认知策略作为调节变量。
AI.method: 在技术咨询公司进行的随机对照现场实验，将员工随机分配到接受LLM辅助组和对照组，通过主管和外部评估者评分测量创造力。
AI.findings: 1. LLM辅助显著提升员工创造力；2. 认知工作资源是中介机制；3. 元认知策略水平高的员工从LLM辅助中获益更多，创造力提升更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统提出LLM辅助影响创造力的理论视角；2. 识别认知工作资源的中介作用；3. 揭示元认知策略的调节机制，丰富了技术辅助与创造力关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织引入LLM辅助提供实证依据；2. 建议组织在部署LLM时关注员工元认知能力发展；3. 为个性化技术培训提供指导，最大化技术辅助的创造力效益。

title: The Validator-Layer Model: A Lightweight Framework for Universal Digital Verification

detail.title: The Validator-Layer Model: A Lightweight Framework for Universal Digital Verification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest. The Validator-Layer Model (VLM) was developed independently by the author without influence from any commercial entity, investor, or affiliated organization. No third party has shaped, directed, or influenced the findings, architecture, or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or interventions requiring institutional ethics approval. No personal or sensitive data was collected or analyzed.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The development of the Validator-Layer Model (VLM) was entirely self-funded by the author.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This work has not been previously published or accepted for publication. No DOI exists at this time. SSRN may assign a DOI upon acceptance.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Validator-Layer Model (VLM), a system-level architecture for universal verification across heterogeneous digital ecosystems. The VLM implements a modular, protocol-agnostic layer capable of validating the internal logic of digital objects—including stablecoins, financial transactions, media artifacts, identity tokens, and real-world assets—through deterministic rule-sets executed at runtime. By separating validation from application logic, the VLM enables transparent compliance, reduces systemic and operational risk, and establishes interoperability between independently governed platforms. The paper details the VLM’s architectural components, validation flows, implementation pathways, and cross-domain applications, with emphasis on regulatory-grade blockchain compliance and large-scale digital media governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了验证器层模型(VLM)，这是一种用于异构数字生态系统通用验证的系统级架构。VLM实现了一个模块化、协议无关的层，能够通过运行时执行的确定性规则集来验证数字对象（包括稳定币、金融交易、媒体制品、身份令牌和现实世界资产）的内部逻辑。通过将验证与应用逻辑分离，VLM实现了透明合规、降低了系统和操作风险，并在独立治理的平台之间建立了互操作性。
AI.research_question: 如何在异构数字生态系统中实现通用、协议无关的验证架构，以支持跨领域数字对象的透明合规和互操作性？
AI.motivation: 当前数字生态系统面临验证碎片化、合规不透明、系统风险高以及平台间互操作性差的问题，需要一种统一的验证架构来解决这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 验证器层模型(VLM)理论框架，包括模块化架构设计、协议无关性原理、验证与应用逻辑分离理论、确定性规则集执行机制。
AI.method: 系统架构设计方法，包括VLM的组件设计、验证流程建模、实现路径分析，以及跨领域应用案例研究。
AI.findings: VLM能够有效实现跨异构数字生态系统的通用验证，支持透明合规、降低系统风险，并建立平台间互操作性，特别适用于监管级区块链合规和大规模数字媒体治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了验证器层模型(VLM)作为系统级验证架构的理论框架，发展了验证与应用逻辑分离的理论基础，建立了协议无关验证的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字生态系统提供了可实施的验证架构方案，支持稳定币、金融交易、媒体制品、身份令牌和现实世界资产等多种数字对象的合规验证，具有监管合规和风险管理的实际应用价值。

title: The Sanitization Paradox: How AI-Generated Comment Summaries Reduce Participation Yet Fuel Toxicity
affiliations: University of Wisconsin Milwaukee and University of Wisconsin - Milwaukee - Sheldon B. Lubar School of Business

detail.title: The Sanitization Paradox: How AI-Generated Comment Summaries Reduce Participation Yet Fuel Toxicity
detail.abstract: Online discourse has grown rapidly in both volume and toxicity, threatening platforms’ ability to host constructive debate. With advances in generative AI, platforms now deploy opinion summarizers to help users efficiently grasp existing viewpoints. These summaries, however, often sanitize toxic content, potentially distorting the opinion landscape users perceive. The behavioral consequences of such algorithmic curation remain unknown. This study investigates how AI-generated comment summaries affect the volume and toxicity of user comments. We develop our hypotheses by synthesizing the collective effort model and psychological reactance theory. Leveraging a natural experiment, we identify the causal effects of displaying AI-generated comment summaries and test our hypotheses. Our results show that displaying AI-generated comment summaries leads to a substantial decline in the volume of following comments. However, the toxicity of the comments increases significantly. Further mechanism explorations indicate that the reduction in comment volume is driven by the summary’s coverage ratio of opinions. Additionally, AI’s sanitization bias, i.e., the lack of representation of toxic opinion in the summary, drives the increase in comment toxicity. Comprehensive robustness checks validate these results. The findings offer valuable insights for AI summarization algorithm design and content moderation strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨AI生成的评论摘要如何影响用户评论的数量和毒性。通过自然实验发现，显示AI摘要会显著减少后续评论数量，但同时增加评论毒性。减少评论数量是因为摘要覆盖了现有观点，而增加毒性则是因为摘要过滤了有毒内容，引发用户反应。
AI.research_question: AI生成的评论摘要如何影响用户评论的数量和毒性？
AI.motivation: 在线讨论的规模和毒性都在快速增长，威胁平台建设性辩论的举办。虽然平台使用AI意见摘要帮助用户理解现有观点，但这些摘要通常会净化有毒内容，可能扭曲用户感知的意见格局。这种算法策展的行为后果尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体努力模型和心理学反抗理论的综合应用
AI.method: 利用自然实验识别显示AI生成评论摘要的因果效应，并进行机制探索和稳健性检验
AI.findings: 1. 显示AI生成的评论摘要导致后续评论数量大幅下降；2. 评论毒性显著增加；3. 评论数量减少由摘要对意见的覆盖率驱动；4. 毒性增加由AI的净化偏见（即摘要中缺乏有毒意见的代表性）驱动
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证检验AI意见摘要对用户行为的影响；2. 整合集体努力模型和反抗理论解释AI策展的行为后果；3. 揭示算法净化如何引发用户反应性行为
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI摘要算法设计提供见解；2. 为内容审核策略提供指导；3. 帮助平台平衡信息效率和社区健康

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Presence Memory Framework (PMF), a conceptual architecture for capturing, structuring, and replaying multidimensional slices of human experience across time and space. While traditional imaging systems—photography, film, digital cameras, AR/VR, and emerging Metaverse environments—have progressively increased sensory fidelity, they still fail to capture the full cognitive-emotional relational context that defines human Presence.

The PMF formalizes five foundational experiential elements (Time, Space, Motion, Dimension, and Presence) and proposes a four-layer model for extracting and replaying “Presence Slices,” defined as bounded units of temporal-spatial-cognitive experience. Each slice encodes perceptual, affective, and relational patterns that extend beyond conventional media formats or biological memory reconstruction.

Although technologically infeasible with current hardware, PMF provides the first structured roadmap for future experiential computing systems capable of memory sampling, emotional resonance modeling, multi-agent relational capture, and controlled time-space re-injection. Potential applications span defense simulation, medical rehabilitation, neural augmentation, cognitive therapy, and next-generation conscious user interfaces. The framework establishes a foundation for long-horizon research in experiential time-space systems and multi-century human-computer co-evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"存在记忆框架"(PMF)，这是一个用于捕捉、组织和回放跨时空人类体验多维切片的架构。传统成像系统无法捕捉完整的人类存在认知情感关系背景，PMF通过五个基本体验元素和四层模型来提取和回放"存在切片"。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地捕捉、组织和回放人类体验的多维切片，超越传统媒体格式和生物记忆重建的限制？
AI.motivation: 传统成像系统（摄影、电影、数字相机、AR/VR、元宇宙）虽然逐步提高了感官保真度，但仍无法捕捉定义人类存在的完整认知-情感关系背景。需要一个新的框架来捕捉人类体验的多维本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存在记忆框架(PMF)：基于五个基本体验元素（时间、空间、运动、维度、存在）和四层模型，用于提取和回放"存在切片"（定义为时空认知体验的有界单元）。
AI.method: 概念架构设计方法：提出PMF作为未来体验计算系统的结构化路线图，包括记忆采样、情感共鸣建模、多智能体关系捕捉和受控时空重新注入等概念。
AI.findings: PMF提供了第一个结构化路线图，用于未来能够进行记忆采样、情感共鸣建模、多智能体关系捕捉和受控时空重新注入的体验计算系统。虽然当前硬件技术不可行，但为长期研究奠定了基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）形式化了五个基本体验元素；2）提出了四层模型用于提取和回放存在切片；3）建立了体验时空系统和多世纪人机协同进化的长期研究基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 潜在应用包括：国防模拟、医疗康复、神经增强、认知治疗和下一代有意识用户界面。为未来体验计算系统提供了具体的发展方向。

detail.abstract: This study examines how Generation Z physicians in India engage with pharmaceutical companies, with a specific focus on digital communication and clinical evidence preferences that shape trust and prescribing intent. Using an exploratory mixed-methods design, a focus group with cross-functional pharmaceutical professionals was conducted to derive key themes, which were subsequently validated through a structured survey of 110 physicians from urban and semi-urban regions. Respondents showed strong preferences for personalized communication, with 87.5 percent favoring tailored content, and a clear inclination toward hybrid phygital engagement was reported by 67.5 percent of the participants. Real-world clinical evidence emerged as a dominant driver of treatment decisions, with 96.8 percent reporting a high reliance on such evidence, showing a strong statistical association with decision-making (p < 0.0001). Ethical marketing practices were considered important by 83.5 percent of respondents, and over 75 percent valued environmental and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Both factors showed a directional association with higher trust in the company-provided materials (p < 0.05). Collectively, these findings indicate a generational shift toward evidence-driven, value-based, and digitally fluent professional engagement. This study offers practical guidance for medical affairs and commercial teams on packaging and communicating clinical and real-world evidence to align with Generation Z expectations and to strengthen credibility, relevance, and trust-based pharma-HCP relationships in routine care.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了印度Z世代医生如何与制药公司互动，重点关注数字沟通和临床证据偏好如何影响信任和处方意向。研究发现Z世代医生偏好个性化沟通、混合式数字-实体互动，并高度依赖真实世界临床证据，同时重视伦理营销和企业社会责任。
AI.research_question: 印度Z世代医生如何与制药公司互动？数字沟通和临床证据偏好如何影响他们的信任和处方意向？
AI.motivation: 随着Z世代医生进入医疗行业，他们的沟通偏好和决策方式与前辈不同，需要了解这一代医生如何与制药公司互动，以便建立有效的专业关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际差异理论、信任建立理论、专业沟通理论、证据医学决策理论
AI.method: 采用探索性混合方法设计：首先进行跨职能制药专业人士焦点小组讨论，提取关键主题；随后通过结构化问卷调查验证，样本为110名来自城市和半城市地区的医生。
AI.findings: 1. 87.5%的受访者偏好个性化沟通内容；2. 67.5%倾向于混合式数字-实体互动；3. 96.8%高度依赖真实世界临床证据，与决策有强统计关联(p<0.0001)；4. 83.5%重视伦理营销实践；5. 超过75%重视环境和企业社会责任倡议；6. 伦理营销和企业社会责任与对公司材料的信任度呈正相关(p<0.05)。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了Z世代医生专业互动的代际转变特征；2. 建立了证据驱动、价值导向和数字流畅的专业参与理论框架；3. 阐明了伦理因素在建立信任关系中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为医学事务和商业团队提供实用指导，指导如何包装和沟通临床及真实世界证据；2. 帮助制药公司调整沟通策略以符合Z世代期望；3. 提供增强可信度、相关性和基于信任的制药-医生关系的具体建议。

title: A Network Model of Information Aging
affiliations: National Technical University of Ukraine - Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute and A&I, Tata Consultancy Services

detail.title: A Network Model of Information Aging
detail.abstract: In this paper, we propose a quantitative model of information aging that advances the concept of memory as a dynamic projection of an event network, in which time emerges not as an absolute quantity but as a partial order induced by causal relationships. In contrast to the classical Burton-Kebler model, which describes utility as the exponential decay of the value of individual documents (stable and current), our work formalizes information utility as a function of the integrity of causal paths between historically significant "anchors." The model explicitly distinguishes between the forgetting of events, S(v,τ), and the forgetting of their linkcausal R C (e, τ) and associative R A (e,τ)and corroborates the empirical hypothesis that causal links degrade faster than events themselves (β > α). The model incorporates phase transitions in information aging: when a critical "bridge" between clusters of anchors is lost, utility does not merely decline but drops discontinuously to zero, as network connectivity is severed. This phenomenon is analogous to a percolation transition in complex network theory. Based on this, we derive a generalized utility formula that combines a smooth exponential component (for bulk decay) and a threshold function (for critical points). The model has been validated on a 30-year news archive (>1 billion records) and is accompanied by a Python implementation. Results confirm that the strategic preservation of "bridges" not only mitigates gradual aging but also eliminates the risk of catastrophic collapse of meaning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种信息老化的定量模型，将记忆视为事件网络的动态投影，时间由因果关系诱导而非绝对量。与经典的Burton-Kebler模型不同，该模型将信息效用定义为历史重要"锚点"间因果路径完整性的函数，区分事件遗忘和链接遗忘，并验证了因果链接比事件本身退化更快的假设。模型包含信息老化的相变：当锚点集群间的关键"桥梁"丢失时，效用不连续降为零。该模型在30年新闻档案上验证，并提供了Python实现。
AI.research_question: 如何定量建模信息老化过程，特别是考虑因果关系的动态性和网络连通性对信息效用的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统信息老化模型（如Burton-Kebler模型）将信息效用视为个体文档价值的指数衰减，忽略了信息间的因果关系和网络结构。现实中，信息的价值不仅取决于其自身的新旧，还取决于其在因果网络中的位置和连通性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 记忆作为事件网络的动态投影理论；2. 时间作为因果关系诱导的部分序；3. 复杂网络理论中的渗流相变；4. 信息老化的双组分模型：平滑指数衰减和阈值函数。
AI.method: 1. 提出定量数学模型，区分事件遗忘S(v,τ)和链接遗忘R_C(e,τ)、R_A(e,τ)；2. 推导广义效用公式，结合指数衰减和阈值函数；3. 使用30年新闻档案（>10亿条记录）进行实证验证；4. 提供Python实现。
AI.findings: 1. 因果链接比事件本身退化更快（β > α）；2. 信息老化存在相变：当关键"桥梁"丢失时，效用不连续降为零；3. 战略性保护"桥梁"不仅能缓解渐进老化，还能消除意义灾难性崩溃的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出基于网络连通性的信息老化新理论框架；2. 将时间概念化为因果关系诱导的部分序；3. 将复杂网络理论中的渗流相变引入信息科学；4. 建立区分事件遗忘和链接遗忘的定量模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供可计算的信息老化模型和Python实现；2. 为信息保存策略提供指导：重点保护关键"桥梁"；3. 帮助预测和防止信息网络连通性的灾难性崩溃；4. 适用于大规模历史档案的管理和保存。

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Meiji University (Grant No. 4122242013).

detail.abstract: The paper explores these issues of national intelligence security of opensource artificial intelligence models and proposes a change to focus of governance to emphasize on pre-emptive prevention, instead of accounting of incidents. Taking a technical viewpoint, it break downs open-source to three-dimensional representation: technology and algorithms, datasets, and object-oriented approaches and uses it to analyse the subject systematically. At a technical (algorithmic level) level, it argues that fundamental algorithms are already publicly accessible, the danger is not in the technology, but in weaknesses generated through harmful use with classified data. At the data level it makes a distinction between the security properties of various data types and suggest a collaborative regulatory approach in terms of state maintained blacklists of the datas and enterprise submitted whitelists of data. In solving the problem of the unintended leaks due to the conspicuity of the models, the paper will propose the postprocessing security filters and the human-in-the-loop risk reduction approaches to issues instead of naive blame-shifting on enterprises. On the object-oriented level, this paper is talking about different risks and access control strategies of the fully opensource models and the limited open-source models, which are available to chosen entities due to the openness of access permissions. Lastly, the paper will argue that the major obstacles are the ambiguity in defining the concept of national security and the slowness of the conventional ex post remedial laws. The governance of the future should be better defined on security measures and shift to technology-focused, visionary legal system, which encourages governance ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨开源人工智能模型的国家情报安全问题，提出治理重点应从事件追责转向预防性监管。从技术视角将开源分解为算法、数据和对象导向三个维度进行系统分析，针对不同风险提出相应治理策略，主张建立技术导向、前瞻性的法律体系。
AI.research_question: 如何有效治理开源人工智能模型带来的国家情报安全风险？
AI.motivation: 开源AI模型快速发展带来新的国家安全挑战，现有治理模式以事后追责为主，缺乏预防性监管框架，需要从技术角度重新审视治理策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术分解框架：1) 算法层面 - 基础算法公开性分析；2) 数据层面 - 数据类型安全属性区分；3) 对象导向层面 - 完全开源与有限开源模型的风险差异。
AI.method: 采用技术分析框架，将开源AI分解为三个维度进行系统性分析：技术算法层面、数据集层面、对象导向层面，并基于此提出治理建议。
AI.findings: 1) 算法本身不是主要风险，风险在于机密数据的恶意使用；2) 不同类型数据需要差异化安全策略；3) 完全开源与有限开源模型需要不同的访问控制策略；4) 主要障碍是国家安全概念模糊和传统事后补救法律的滞后性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了开源AI的三维技术分析框架，区分了算法、数据和对象导向层面的安全特性，为理解开源AI安全风险提供了系统性理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 建议从追责转向预防性治理；2) 提出数据黑名单/白名单协作监管模式；3) 推荐后处理安全过滤器和人机协同风险降低方法；4) 主张建立技术导向、前瞻性的法律体系。

title: A Descriptive-Correlational Analysis of Social Media Usage and Personal Finance Competencies Among University Students
affiliations: , Bukidnon State University, Bukidnon State University and Bukidnon State University

detail.title: A Descriptive-Correlational Analysis of Social Media Usage and Personal Finance Competencies Among University Students
detail.abstract: Social media plays a major role in the lives of young adults, yet there is a lack of understanding about how it influences financial competencies among university students in the Philippines. This study employed a descriptive correlational design to determine the relationship between social media usage and personal finance competencies among students at Bukidnon State University Talisayan Campus. Key findings indicate that social media usage is high, with Facebook and TikTok being the most popular platforms. Financial literacy was found to be moderate, suggesting that students grasp financial concepts but struggle to apply them. The study also demonstrated a moderate positive correlation between social media use and financial literacy, as well as decision-making skills. The researchers recommend that universities incorporate practical financial education into their curricula, utilize social media for financial literacy campaigns, and offer tools to help students effectively manage their finances.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了菲律宾大学生社交媒体使用与个人理财能力之间的关系，发现社交媒体使用率高，Facebook和TikTok最受欢迎，金融素养中等，社交媒体使用与金融素养和决策技能呈中度正相关。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体使用如何影响菲律宾大学生的个人理财能力？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体在年轻人生活中扮演重要角色，但缺乏对菲律宾大学生社交媒体使用如何影响其理财能力的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体影响理论、金融素养理论、决策理论
AI.method: 描述性相关研究设计，调查Bukidnon State University Talisayan Campus的学生
AI.findings: 1. 社交媒体使用率高，Facebook和TikTok最受欢迎；2. 金融素养中等，学生理解金融概念但应用困难；3. 社交媒体使用与金融素养和决策技能呈中度正相关
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了社交媒体使用与金融素养之间的正相关关系，为社交媒体教育影响理论提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 建议大学将实践性金融教育纳入课程，利用社交媒体开展金融素养宣传活动，并提供财务管理工具

detail.abstract: FLASH USDT is a TRC20-compliant stablecoin engineered for high-frequency, high-volume transactions in gaming, casino, and OTC markets in Asia. Designed for operators handling $10M-$100M+ daily volume, FLASH USDT solves the limitations of existing USDT implementations, including slow settlement, high fees, and batch processing constraints. By leveraging optimized batch minting, predictable transaction behavior, and secure TRC20 token standards, FLASH USDT enables reliable, scalable operations for gaming platforms, casino operators, and OTC desks. This paper provides detailed technical specifications, operational workflows, and mitigation strategies for high-volume transaction processing.

AI.tldr: FLASH USDT是一种专为亚洲游戏、赌场和场外交易市场高频大额交易设计的TRC20稳定币，通过优化批量铸造和可预测交易行为解决现有USDT实现的速度慢、费用高和批量处理限制问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种能够满足亚洲游戏、赌场和场外交易市场高频大额交易需求的TRC20稳定币解决方案？
AI.motivation: 现有USDT实现存在结算速度慢、交易费用高、批量处理能力有限等问题，无法满足亚洲游戏、赌场和场外交易市场日交易量1000万至1亿美元以上的高频大额交易需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于TRC20代币标准、高频交易理论、批量处理优化理论以及稳定币在特定应用场景的设计原则。
AI.method: 通过技术规范设计、操作流程优化和风险缓解策略开发，包括优化的批量铸造机制、可预测的交易行为设计和安全增强措施。
AI.findings: FLASH USDT通过优化的批量铸造、可预测的交易行为和安全的TRC20标准，能够为游戏平台、赌场运营商和场外交易柜台提供可靠、可扩展的高频大额交易解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对特定行业应用场景的稳定币设计框架，扩展了TRC20标准在高频交易环境下的应用理论，丰富了稳定币在非传统金融领域的应用研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为亚洲游戏、赌场和场外交易市场提供了专门的高频大额交易稳定币解决方案，降低了交易成本，提高了结算效率，增强了系统的可扩展性和可靠性。
